tags.description: The Hatta Mountain Reserve was created in 2014 with an area of ​​27 km2. In 2017, the area of ​​the reserve was modified, leaving an area of ​​20.96 km2. The borders between Dubai and Ajman have nothing to do with this modification.

tags.description: Five (5) large metal frames hold up five large letters "HATTA" that are illuminated in the night. The letters face North West from here. It also serves as a viewpoint facing North West.
tags.name: Hatta Mountain Sign - علامة جبل حتا
tags.note: I made an area to indicate the size and orientation of the sign. This area is for the sign construction only, not the grounds around it.
